mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, we are looking at 57 degrees with overcast conditions near Badger Prairie County Park, and the moon is currently in a waxing crescent phase.
There are no updates from the city or new emails at this time, so we are keeping things simple today.

We have plenty to look forward to today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company tomorrow.
On September 5th, the Verona Police Department responded to reports of local vehicles having slices of cheese placed on their windshields as part of a social media trend.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel, but they will be ready to welcome you today when they open at 10:00 AM.
